buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Experience Criteria: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for 3 years before the bid opening date. Copies of relevant contracts to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the year. In case of bunch bids, the primary product having highest value should meet this criterion. 2. Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): NA Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: CONSIGNEE 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of PFA/NFR/MLG payable at MALIGAON . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 4. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 5. Purchase Preference (Centre) Purchase preference to Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs): Purchase preference will be given to MSEs as defined in Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) Order, 2012 dated 23.03.2012 issued by Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and its subsequent Orders/Notifications issued by concerned Ministry. If the bidder wants to avail the Purchase preference, the bidder must be the manufacturer of the offered product in case of bid for supply of goods. Traders are excluded from the purview of Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises. In respect of bid for Services, the bidder must be the Service provider of the offered Service. Relevant documentary evidence in this regard shall be uploaded along with the bid in respect of the offered product or service. If L-1 is not an MSE and MSE Seller (s) has/have quoted price within L-1+ 15% of margin of purchase

preference /price band defined in relevant policy, such Seller shall be given opportunity to match L-1 price and contract will be awarded for percentage of 20% of total value. 6. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 7. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Eligibility & Proven Performance Requirement The Railway reserves the right to procure the item only from the original manufacturer or their authorized agent/distributor having proven past performance. Bidders must have executed at least 20% same or simil ar in a single contract with any Government organization in the last three years as of the bid opening date. Documentary evidence must be submitted with the offer, including copies of recent Purchase Orders, Receipt Notes, GeM Contracts, and CRAC/CRAN. Non-submission of such documents will be considered as no past performance, and such offers will be summarily rejected. No representation will be entertained in this regard. 2. Bid Authorization Requirement Only manufacturers or their authorized distributors/dealers/agents with bid-specific authorization are eligib le to quote. OEMs may authorize their agents to quote on their behalf through a Bid-Specific Authorization Letter, provided that: The manufacturer accepts full responsibility for product quality and warranty obligations. Inspection and dispatch must take place at the manufacturer's premises. Offers without a Bid-Specific Authorization Letter (if not submitted by the OEM directly) will be summarily r ejected. 3. Verification of Authorization Bidders must provide contact details (email ID and phone number) of the authorization letter issuing autho rity, along with the head office email, to verify the authenticity of the authorization. 4. Inspection & Dispatch Location Materials must be inspected as per Coveragae PO and dispatched strictly from the OEM's premises. Any de viation will result in summary rejection of the offer. 5. Inspection Clause Offers with conditional inspection will be summarily rejected. No representation will be entertained in such cases. 6. Bidder's Undertaking

The bidder must submit an undertaking on their letterhead, duly signed and sealed, confirming execution of the order as per buyer specifications. The undertaking must state: "Our offer against GeM Bid No. ____________ does not contain any deviation from the stipulated bid conditio ns, and we accept all the terms and conditions of the bid document without any deviations." Incomplete or non-submission of this undertaking will lead to summary rejection of the offer. No further cor respondence will be entertained. 6. Unit of Measurement The buying unit is in Kgs. Bidders must quote prices accordingly. 7. Firm Status Validity The status of the firm will be considered as on the date of bid opening. Any changes thereafter will not be considered, except in the case of removal/suspension/banning. 8. Delivery Schedule Time is the essence of the contract. Bidders must quote delivery schedules strictly in line with the bid docu ment. Vague or broad timelines (e.g., “2–28 weeks” or “3–8 months”) or unreasonably long periods may b e treated as commercially unresponsive, and such offers are liable to be ignored. 9. EMD Requirement Bidders must submit EMD as per the Railway Board guidelines. Offers without EMD will be summarily reject ed, unless the bidder is exempted under the latest Ministry guidelines on public procurement. 11. Delivery Undertaking Firms must provide an undertaking on their letterhead to execute the order within 30 days. Non submissio n of this undertaking will lead to summary rejection. No further correspondence in this regard will be enter tained. 12. Applicable Terms IRS (Indian Railway Standard) terms and conditions shall apply to this tender. . 9. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid
